evidence: Method: enumerated every value a criterion/protocol tells the judge to create, then grepped the frozen seed (environment/assets/seed_data.json sha256 a1c65c80..., identical to solution/app/src/seed_data.json) and the reference markup/JS (index.html dff857e8..., app.js 6ce330f3..., board.js a177dc0c..., threads.js 72371e86..., index.js 708f94cb..., all matching raw-evidence-index.json). (1) No fixed sentinel exists in any judge-created mutation: functional prompt.md:15 'Use your own new jobs and cards for every board protocol (suffix every title and name for this review)'; gates/constraints criterion and the polish/visual gate require 'a unique title', 'a unique name, a unique email address'. J1/J2/J3 and A-F, V-Z, A2 are only labels; grep for J1/J2/J3/JUDGE/Judge/probe in seed and reference returns 0 hits. Rejection reasons, notes, messages and drafts are judge-chosen text. (2) The only literal example probe is polish hro_pol_live_board 'Call back on Fri' ('such as'); 0 hits in seed and reference. hro_pol_failed_send/session_resume ask for 'distinctive' replies; polish prompt also says 'If a message or note box already holds text from an earlier review, record it and clear it before typing your own', so a pre-existing draft cannot satisfy a draft row. Reference drafts live only in per-person localStorage (app.js:38-42, threads.js:112,124,182,196); seed has no drafts. (3) Seeded literals the judge reads are deliberate baselines/controls, not mutation probes, and do not make a mutation look done: Z/hro_restart seeded order (seed APP-105/106/108 Applied pos 1-3 Greta, Ade, Marco; APP-103/104 Screen Priya, Samuel) and Noor's note 'Strong systems answers; weaker on incident follow-up.' (seed notes[0]) are preservation checks; Lena's start of 1 unread (seed reads USR-CAN3/APP-301 read_count 2 of 3 messages, last by REC3) is a baseline and hro_unread_counts still requires Rafael's count to rise by exactly two etc. (4) Mutation-sensitive states start clean: Rafael's read marker on Noor's APP-101 is 120 of 120 (0 unread), so hro_unread_scrolled_up's 'one new message' notice and unread state are not pre-satisfied; Tomas's seeded APP-201 (Data Analyst) differs from the new uniquely titled J2 card, so hro_candidate_linked is not satisfied by the seed (prompt T even adds J3 fallback 'if that address is already on J2'); tomas.varga@candidates.example appears in seed only as his account/APP-201 by design (the link mechanism under test). Rejections (hro_reject_reason, hro_candidate_private) target judge-created cards, not seeded rejected APP-301. Activity/filter rows (hro_activity) are scoped to the judge's own J1/J2; seed has no activity lines. Adversarial reasoning: a broken app that never saves a new job/card/note/message cannot show a suffixed, judge-chosen value because none exists in seed or markup; a conforming alternative app is not penalised by any probe because nothing requires a specific value. Deterministic analogue check-probe-not-in-seed.py would skip (no named sentinels) or pass on 'Call back on Fri'. Residual (P3, no defect): functional S does not explicitly say candidate emails must be unique (only names/titles suffixed), but gates require unique emails and a seeded-email collision would not pre-satisfy any criterion. Only source/grep evidence; no configured judge run was performed or needed for this row.
